events.title: Pound Rises As U.K. Unemployment Rate Falls
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, after the U.K. unemployment rate declined in the three months to August.

events.title: GM Q3 Profit Surges, Revises FY26 Earnings View, Plans $20 Bln Buyback; Stock Drops
events.description: Shares of General Motors Co. were losing around 6 percent in the pre-market activity on the NYSE after the automajor revised its fiscal 2026 earnings view, raising the lower end of range, but trimming the higher end. This was despite reporting strong growth in third-quarter earnings. The firm also announced a new $20 billion multi-year share repurchase program and declared quarterly dividend.

events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls On Fading Fed Rate Hike Hopes
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, due to declining expectations of Federal Reserve (Fed) rate rises and worries over AI overinvestment.

events.title: FTSE 100 Down 0.6% As Miners, Bank Stocks Decline Sharply
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark FTSE 100 drifted lower on Tuesday, weighed down by losses in mining and bank stocks. Rising political unrest in several parts of Europe, particularly in France and Italy, and high oil prices hurt sentiment.

events.title: French Stocks Fall On Political Tensions, Oil Price Surge
events.description: French stocks declined Tuesday amid rising political unrest, elevated oil prices from regional conflicts, and AI valuation concerns. The CAC 40 benchmark fell 0.61%, with notable declines in industrials and financials. Eurozone current account surplus contracted significantly.

events.title: German Stocks Fall On Oil Surge, Political Tensions
events.description: German stocks declined Tuesday as rising Brent crude prices, escalating European political tensions, and accelerating producer price inflation weighed on sentiment. The DAX dropped 0.86%, with energy and industrial stocks leading losses.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower As Brent Returns To $110
events.description: Gold prices traded lower on Tuesday as rising oil prices rekindled inflation and interest-rate concerns.

events.title: Oil Prices Climb As Investors Weigh Supply Risks
events.description: Oil prices rose on Tuesday to reach their highest levels since May due to Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia infrastructure and reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: European Shares Extend Losses Amid France's Debt Crisis
events.description: European stocks traded lower on Tuesday, extending losses from the previous session as a recovery in artificial intelligence shares faltered and Brent crude prices topped $110 a barrel due to Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia infrastructure and reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat Amid AI Jitters
events.description: Asian stocks retreated on Tuesday amid renewed concerns over AI-related investments and escalating protests in France.

events.title: European Shares Poised For Lower Open Amid Debt Concerns
events.description: European stocks look set to open lower on Tuesday as investors fret over rising debt levels in Europe and tightening financial conditions.
